conclusions: early_projection_filter: optimized median was not faster (216.075 ms versus 183.939 ms).
broadcast_joins: optimized median was faster (561.944 ms versus 762.517 ms).
adaptive_duplicate_aggregation: optimized median was not faster (426.586 ms versus 347.056 ms).
reused_frame_cache: optimized median was not faster (372.224 ms versus 323.322 ms).
file_layout: optimized median was faster (1645.82 ms versus 2787.065 ms).

layout.reason: unpartitioned output avoids tiny month directories

limitations: The workload is too small for Spark throughput benefits.
Measurements are local-mode results and do not represent a cluster.
Warm runs reduce startup and JIT noise but cannot remove filesystem-cache effects.
Snowflake SQL remains the production semantic layer.
